display.purpose: Page heroes only; italic serif carries all emotional register.

headline.purpose: Section h2s, often italic with a colored emphasis span.

body.purpose: All informational copy, 15.5px, anthracite/70-75 on light backgrounds.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked eyebrows, table headers, stat captions. Short labels only.

shadows.name: navbar-scroll
shadows.purpose: Navbar only, appears after scrollY > 8. Everything else is flat.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Patina-filled CTA; sharp corners, verb-object label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #836479; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #957a8b; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6667AB; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: transparent; color: #6667AB; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid #6667AB; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s, background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: rgba(102,103,171,0.06); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6667AB; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Tracked uppercase micro-label above hero/section headings.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.22em; color: #6667AB; line-height: 1; margin: 0; }

components.name: Diamond List Item
components.description: The house bullet: rotated-square marker in a program color.
components.css: .ds-diamond-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-family: 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; font-size: 15.5px; color: rgba(45,45,49,0.75); line-height: 1.6; } .ds-diamond { width: 6px; height: 6px; background: #6667AB; transform: rotate(45deg); flex: none; }

components.name: Display Heading
components.description: Serif italic hero heading with datum emphasis span.
components.html: We build the builders New Jersey is counting on.
components.css: .ds-display { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; font-size: 2.75rem; line-height: 1.05; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: #2D2D31; margin: 0; max-width: 15ch; text-wrap: balance; } .ds-display span { color: #6667AB; }

narrative.overview: A datum is the reference line every measurement on a drawing comes back to. This system treats the page the same way: one periwinkle anchor color, sharp corners everywhere, serif italic display type doing the emotional work while a geometric grotesque body stays factual. It signals institutional seriousness, not marketing enthusiasm; credibility is carried by typography, spacing, and controlled color rather than decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp corners sitewide (single exception: PageCTA rounded-t-[2rem])
Cormorant Garamond italic for display, Space Grotesk for fact
Snow / bone / anthracite section alternation, no same-tone seams
The diamond is the house glyph
Light mode only; every animation gated on useReducedMotion()

rules.name: The Program Color Rule
rules.body: Explore=datum, Pathway=quarry, Launch=sediment, Rebuild=rebuild(-deep); Services.tsx is the source of truth; Talent Pipeline gets no program color.

rules.name: The Datum-Light Rule
rules.body: On bg-anthracite, plain datum is forbidden for text/links/focus; swap to datum-light.

rules.name: The Alternation Rule
rules.body: Adjacent sections never share a background tone.

rules.name: The Italic Carries the Voice Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is a serif-italic (often colored) span, never bolded or enlarged body text.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn with 1px rules at anthracite/12 (light) or white/12-15 (dark), never boxes or shadows.

dos: Do gate every animation behind useReducedMotion(); never gate content visibility on animation state.
Do use EASE [0.25,0.1,0.25,1], SPRING [0.32,0.72,0,1], VIEWPORT { once: true, margin: '100px 0px' } exactly.
Do hold WCAG AA: datum-light on anthracite, rebuild-deep under white body text, anthracite/70+ body on light backgrounds.
Do keep py-12 lg:py-18 section rhythm (py-14 lg:py-20 on anthracite).
Do use the diamond as the marker glyph.
donts: Don't build SaaS landing pages with hero metrics and gradient text.
Don't use stock photography or rounded corners (PageCTA top arc excepted).
Don't build generic nonprofit homepages or consultancy services grids.
Don't re-add the hero audience selector, ghost watermarks, or ghost section numerals.
Don't use raw rebuild under white body text or raw datum on anthracite.
Don't put adjacent sections on the same background tone.
